realtime_safety.details: Stage 4 adds only applyConceptPreset (PluginProcessor.cpp:439), invoked exclusively by the WebView 'applyPreset' native function on the message thread (PluginEditor.cpp:123-127; JS binds via Juce.getNativeFunction in app.js:577). A grep confirms NO reference to it from processBlock or any audio-thread helper. It introduces no lock on the audio path: setValueNotifyingHost may take the uncontended APVTS parameter lock, but only off the audio thread, and it is correctly NOT marked noexcept (header line 119) with a matching docstring (lines 115-119). Grid mutation uses the existing lock-free clearGrid()/setStep() writers storing std::atomic<uint8_t> with memory_order_relaxed (alloc-free, lock-free) while the audio thread reads the same atomics. processBlock itself is unchanged: ScopedNoDenormals present (line 253), no allocation (sequencerMidi pre-sized to 4096 in prepareToPlay, firingColumns/pending are fixed std::arrays), no locks, no std::function on the audio path, and the only push_back is the OUARICON_BUILD_TESTS-gated test hook that the shipping plugin never compiles.

buffer_handling.details: Audio path unchanged this stage. buffer.clear() before voices add (line 257), channel iteration bounded by buffer.getNumChannels() with a numCh>0 guard (line 364), sampleRate stored in prepareToPlay (line 117) and ScopedNoDenormals at processBlock entry (line 253). Output-only synth bus layout validated in isBusesLayoutSupported. clearGrid() iterates the full 192-cell (6x32) std::array so columns 16..31 are silenced before only columns 0..15 are stamped by the 16-step preset, preventing stale carry-over from longer prior patterns.

parameter_integration.details: applyConceptPreset normalises every preset value through the parameter's own range via convertTo0to1 before setValueNotifyingHost, which is the correct normalisation. swing/humanize/quantize use unitRange 0..1 and all literals (swing 0.00-0.80, humanize 0.00-0.85, quantize 0.25-1.00) lie inside it; tempo uses range 40..240 and all literals (90-120) are in range; patternLength is a 3-choice param (range 0..2) and the literal index 1 maps to convertTo0to1(1.0)=0.5, round-tripping back to index 1. No preset value lands out of range, so nothing is clamped or distorted. The index argument is bounds-checked (lines 441-442), setStep is guarded by inRange (lines 393-394), the editor guards args.size()>=1 (PluginEditor.cpp:124), and the stamp loop is bounded to v<kNumVoices and s<16.

numerical_stability.details: No new numerical hazards introduced this stage. processBlock retains ScopedNoDenormals (line 253) and a block-level NaN/inf scrub that zeros any non-finite output sample (lines 375-381). Preset velocities are integer-clamped by setStep (jlimit 0..127), and all normalised parameter values are produced by convertTo0to1 within [0,1]. No feedback paths or new divisions are added by applyConceptPreset.
